thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: high tail latency for /v1/generate across us-west-2 (p99 > 1.2s) — paging oncall:sara_oncall :rotating_light:

sara_oncall: ack — seeing the alerts, investigating. starting runbook check.

alex_m: saw a spike in queue depth on the request gateway ~10:05 UTC, possible batching backlog.

jamal: confirmed GPU queue grew, some workers at 100% GPU mem and high context-switching. Could be a model variant hotpath.

maria_prod: any customer-facing impact? I just got a ticket from a large customer complaining about timeouts.

sara_oncall: yes — the frontend returned 504 for some requests between 10:04–10:08. Not all customers affected, looks correlated with requests routed to dedicated pool A.

alex_m: quick mitigation — I'm switching routing policy to fallback to cheaper model-variant B in pool B for latency-sensitive routes. Will also enable temporary rate-limit at gateway for heavy upstream callers.

sara_oncall: doing the routing change now.

incident-bot: route change triggered by sara_oncall at 10:09 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy marker: route-rollout/rollback #9876 by alex_m — metadata: reason=latency-spike.

jamal: after the routing change p99 dropped from ~1.4s to 0.48s in 2m. queue depth slowly draining.

maria_prod: notified the impacted customer that we've applied a fallback and are monitoring. They asked for RCA.

sara_oncall: putting this into handoff — i'll stay on for 30m more and then hand to alex_m for root-cause follow-up.

alex_m: I'll pick it up. quick note: we saw prefix cache hit rate drop from 82% to 35% for pool A right before spike. that could explain increased per-token work.

jamal: sounds like cache eviction or mismatch after a deploy of quantized kernels earlier today. Did the kernel flags change?

alex_m: yes, there was a lightweight runtime tweak at 06:30 — recompiled kernels with a new memory allocator. we should correlate.

sara_oncall: action list for post-incident work (short):
- capture timeline + deploy markers (alex_m)
- assess customer impact & outreach log (maria_prod)
- alert tuning: reduce noise, change threshold for queue-depth alert (sara_oncall)
- build a focused Grafana dashboard for the retro (jamal)

maria_prod: noted. i'll collect ticket ids and customer messages and paste into the postmortem doc.

alex_m: timeline: i will grab logs and the deploy diff, and check kernel allocator flags.

jamal: i'll start a Grafana dashboard skeleton — include golden signals and drilldowns we can use in the retro. quick sketch of panels i'll add:
- p99/p95/p50 request latency (per-route and per-model)
- request QPS and request queue depth (avg & max)
- GPU utilization per host and GPU memory pressure
- prefix/KV cache hit rate and eviction rate
- model variant routing percentage (who got routed where)
- 5xx error rate and 504 timeouts count
- deploy markers timeline panel (overlay)
- per-customer latency heatmap (anonymized)

sara_oncall: for alert tuning, propose:
- change queue-depth alert from static 100 -> dynamic threshold: `threshold = 1.5 * p90(queue_depth)` over 5m
- add a cache-hit-rate alert: fire when cache_hit_rate < 50% for 3m AND p99 latency > 700ms
- suppress duplicate 504 alerts if root cause alert (queue-depth/gpu-mem) is already firing.

alex_m: agree. sample PromQL for queue depth alert we can start with:
```
avg_over_time(gateway_request_queue_depth{pool="A"}[5m]) > (1.5 * quantile_over_time(0.9, gateway_request_queue_depth{pool="A"}[1h]))
```

jamal: thanks, i'll wire that into the dashboard as an alert widget and a panel annotation. for retro i'll add drilldowns on panels so clicking p99 takes you to related logs (via link) and the trace view.

maria_prod: also let's add a panel that shows customer-facing errors by region/service so support can quickly see affected customers in future.

sara_oncall: agreed. ownership: jamal => dashboard + wiring (due EOD tomorrow), alex_m => deploy diff + root cause (due tomorrow), maria_prod => customer impact writeup (due EOD today). i'll update rotation to reflect handoff in 30m.

incident-bot: oncall-change: sara_oncall -> alex_m scheduled at 10:43 UTC.

alex_m: taking over now. i'll post updates in the postmortem thread.

jamal: quick note on panel design: use stacked area for cache hit vs miss, and an absolute counter line for eviction events so we can see cause+effect. also enable panel links to the alert rule and the relevant runbook.

sara_oncall: small follow-up — reduce alert flapping: add a 2-minute silence window on queue-depth alerts when a rollout is in progress (deploy marker present).

alex_m: good idea. I'll add a deploy-guard tag to rollout jobs so ops-bot can auto-silence those alerts.

ops-bot: automation: silence-rule created for alert=queue-depth when deploy_marker=true by alex_m.

maria_prod: thanks team. we'll capture all of this in the retro doc and link the new dashboard. full postmortem will include timeline, root cause, mitigations, alert tuning decisions, and preventative tasks.

sara_oncall: closing on-call transfer. if anyone else sees issues ping here. good job all. :tada:

alex_m: filing the RCA draft now. jamal, leave the dashboard as draft and i'll review.

jamal: will do. adding placeholder panels and the PromQL snippets.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED by alex_m — resolved.
